Lim Ah Kow v Tan Boon Huat [2023] SGHC 250

HC/S 412/2022
2023-07-12
General Division of the High Court
Ang Cheng Hock JC
Mr Lee for the Plaintiff; Ms Wong for the Defendant
Lim Ah Kow; Tan Boon Huat
Contract
Breach of Contract — Damages
Tort — Negligence — Duty of Care

Background

1 The plaintiff and defendant entered into a sale and purchase agreement dated 15 March 2020 for a residential property.

2 The plaintiff claims that the defendant breached clause 12 of the agreement by failing to complete the transaction by the stipulated date.

3 The defendant counterclaimed for the return of the deposit sum under section 6 of the Civil Law Act.

Issues

4 The key issues are: (a) whether the defendant breached the agreement; (b) whether the plaintiff is entitled to specific performance or damages.

Analysis

5 Applying the framework in Turf Club Auto Emporium Pte Ltd v Yeo Boong Hua [2017] 2 SLR 12, the court finds that the defendant did breach the agreement.

6 On the measure of damages, the court relied on the principles in Robertson Quay Investment Pte Ltd v Steen Consultants Pte Ltd [2008] 2 SLR(R) 623.

Orders

7 Judgment is entered for the plaintiff. The defendant shall pay damages of $120,000 with interest at 5.33% per annum from the date of writ.

8 Costs to the plaintiff, to be taxed if not agreed.
